mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, course_name, credits, teacher_id, course_day, course_time FROM courses WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, course_id, course_name, credits, teacher_id, course_day, course_time FROM courses WHERE course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT c.id, c.course_id, c.course_name, c.credits, c.teacher_id, c.course_day, c.course_time, t.name as teacher_name FROM courses c LEFT JOIN teachers t ON c.teacher_id = t.id
AND c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{teacherName}, '%')
AND c.course_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseId}, '%')
ORDER BY c.course_id
SELECT id, course_id, course_name, credits, teacher_id, course_day, course_time FROM courses WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courses(course_id, course_name, credits, teacher_id, course_day, course_time) VALUES(#{courseId}, #{courseName}, #{credits}, #{teacherId}, #{courseDay}, #{courseTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE courses SET course_id = #{courseId}, course_name = #{courseName}, credits = #{credits}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, course_day = #{courseDay}, course_time = #{courseTime} WHERE id = #{id}
